# ADR Template

## Status

`Proposed` | `Accepted` | `Superseded` | `Deprecated`

## Context

Explain the problem, constraints, and why a decision is needed.

## Decision

State the chosen option clearly and concisely.

## Alternatives considered

List the main options that were evaluated and why they were not chosen.

## Consequences

Describe the tradeoffs, benefits, and follow-up work created by the decision.

## Related docs

Link to relevant product, architecture, or backlog documents.
